fields.name: poi_id
fields.title: Point of Interest ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for a point of interest. Note that a point of interest should reference a SINGLE direction on a facility. If you have more than one direction, you can create two separate POIs.

fields.name: before_or_after
fields.title: Before or After
fields.description: Whether this POI record describes conditions before or after the project.

fields.name: facility_name
fields.title: Facility Name
fields.description: Name of the facility on which the point of interest lies.

fields.name: segment_length_miles
fields.title: Segment Length (miles)
fields.description: Length of the POI segment, in miles.

fields.name: speed_limit_mph
fields.title: Speed Limit (mph)
fields.description: Posted speed limit at the POI, in miles per hour.

fields.name: lane_width
fields.title: Lane Width
fields.description: Width of travel lanes at the POI, in feet.

fields.name: signals_per_mile
fields.title: Signals per Mile
fields.description: Number of traffic signals per mile along the POI segment.

fields.name: stop_signs_per_mile
fields.title: Stop Signs per Mile
fields.description: Number of stop signs per mile along the POI segment.

fields.name: through_lanes
fields.title: Through Lanes
fields.description: Number of through lanes at the POI.

fields.name: left_turn_lanes
fields.title: Left Turn Lanes
fields.description: Number of left turn lanes at the POI.

fields.name: right_turn_lanes
fields.title: Right Turn Lanes
fields.description: Number of right turn lanes at the POI.

fields.name: express_hov_hot_lanes
fields.title: Express/HOV/HOT Lanes
fields.description: Whether an express, HOV, or HOT lane is present at the POI (1 = yes, 0 = no).

fields.name: shoulder_width
fields.title: Shoulder Width
fields.description: Width of the shoulder at the POI, in feet.
